title: Choose service locations and qualified staff
summary: Configure eligibility and price or timing exceptions without changing existing appointments.

sections.title: Configure Team & locations
sections.body:
1. Open **Services**, choose the service and select **Team & locations**.
2. Choose the locations that can offer it.
3. Select qualified staff who work at an eligible branch.
4. Review optional location prices and the staff price, active-time, processing, cleanup and online controls shown for each selected person. Blank exception fields inherit defaults.
5. Use **Use default price and times** where the person should inherit the standard values.
6. Review any upcoming appointment impact in **Booking & rules**, enter a reason where required and select **Save changes**.

sections.title: Check availability
sections.body: Verify the person’s **Branches they work at** and **Schedule** in Team & availability. Qualification does not add working hours. A staff member and service must share the selected location and have enough usable time and required resources.

sections.title: Why you may not be able to edit
sections.body: A manager needs authority over every configured service branch and the working branches of its qualified staff. A branch-only role may be able to use a service while being unable to change a service shared across other branches.

sections.title: Existing visits and pending bookings
sections.body: Removing a person or branch does not cancel or reassign existing visits. Active booking holds can block changes that would invalidate a client’s reserved selection. Future-dated service settings can also pause current editing; ask an authorized manager to review them.
